visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with reddish-pink hair and white-rimmed glasses sits in a brightly lit indoor room, holding a large black box decorated with a white number pattern. He speaks enthusiastically to the camera, gesturing with his hands. (2) A transition shows a retail display with mahjong sets and printed boxes on a wooden shelf. (3) Back to the man, he opens the box to reveal a black drawstring bag with a similar number pattern. He holds it up to display the design. (4) Close-up views show various accessories, including a red plastic wind indicator and long mahjong rulers in black and translucent white colors with number prints. (5) Detailed shots follow, showcasing a black mahjong tile with white number engravings. The man's hands rotate the tile to show the carved texture and the white face of the tile. (6) The man sits at a table cluttered with numerous mahjong tiles. He uses a ruler to arrange them and then strikes a white ceramic bowl on the table with the ruler while continuing to talk with high energy.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male speaker introduces the mahjong set in Mandarin. The background features an upbeat, synth-driven electronic pop track with a consistent 4/4 beat. The audio environment is clean with no significant background noise. (2) Sounds of rustling plastic and light object impacts occur as the speaker unboxes the items. The vocal intensity remains high with frequent pitch fluctuations. (3) Short, bright clinking sounds are heard as mahjong tiles are handled. The music continues with steady energy. (4) A sharp, resonant percussive strike occurs as a hard object hits a ceramic bowl, followed by the speaker's closing remarks and enthusiastic requests for a product reissue.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Showcase -> Details -> Maintenance Tips -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves to showcase a limited-edition mahjong set designed by SOU·SOU and MACHILL. The creator highlights the aesthetic value of the accessories, specifically the rulers and the engraved tiles, and provides advice on how to maintain the set. It concludes by encouraging viewers to request a reissue from the manufacturer.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The speaker explicitly names the brands SOU·SOU and MACHILL, showcases the product in detail, and encourages the audience to ask for a reissue.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video features high-density subtitles and energetic editing typical of social media product reviews. The sound of striking the ceramic bowl at the end acts as a literal 'bowl-striking' (敲碗) metaphor in Chinese culture for requesting or demanding something.
